# Introduction

This report analyzes long-term ecosystem dynamics at LTER Site 1 in Moorea, French Polynesia. We examine relationships between benthic community composition, environmental conditions, fish assemblages, and ecosystem metabolism over nearly two decades (2005-2025). The analysis integrates multiple datasets to understand how coral reef ecosystems are responding to environmental change.

```{r setup}

#| cache: false

# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)

library(brms)

library(scales)

library(ggraph)
library(igraph)

# Set global theme
theme_set(theme_bw())

# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(223)
```

# Data Processing Pipeline

## 1. Temperature Data

Extract yearly average and maximum daily temperature values from the backreef temperature time series.

```{r temperature-processing}
#| label: process-temperature

# Read and process temperature data
Temp_LTER1 <- read_csv(here("Data", "raw_data", "MCR_LTER02_BTM_Backreef_Forereef_20251114.csv")) |>
  filter(reef_type_code == "Backreef")

# Calculate daily means, then yearly statistics (optimized with single pass)
Mean_year_Temp <- Temp_LTER1 |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(time_local)) |>
  group_by(date) |>
  summarise(daily_temp = mean(temperature_c, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(Year = year(date)) |>
  group_by(Year) |>
  summarise(
    Mean_temp = mean(daily_temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max_temp = max(daily_temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Save processed data
write_csv(Mean_year_Temp, here("Data", "InSituTemp.csv"))

# Quick summary
summary(Mean_year_Temp)
```

## 2. Nutrient Data

Process macroalgae tissue nitrogen content and water column nutrients, using tissue N to impute missing water column data.

```{r nutrient-processing}
#| label: process-nutrients

# Turbinaria %N data (tissue nitrogen as nutrient proxy)
Turb <- read_csv(here("Data", "raw_data", "MCR_LTER_Macroalgal_CHN_2005_to_2024_20250616.csv")) |>
  filter(
    Habitat == "Backreef",
    Genus == "Turbinaria",
    Site == "LTER_1",
    !is.na(N)
  ) |>
  group_by(Year) |>
  summarise(
    N_percent = mean(N, na.rm = TRUE),
    C_percent = mean(C, na.rm = TRUE),
    CN = mean(CN_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(Turb, here("Data", "Turb_mean.csv"))

# Water column nutrients (bimonthly surveys 2005-2018)
water <- read_csv(here("Data", "raw_data", "WaterColumnN.csv")) |>
  mutate(
    Date = mdy(Date),
    Year = year(Date)
  ) |>
  group_by(Year) |>
  summarise(across(Phosphate:Nitrite_and_Nitrate,  \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(Site = "LTER 1")

write_csv(water, here("Data", "Water_N_mean.csv"))

# Impute water N+N from tissue N using linear model
AllNutrients <- Turb |>
  full_join(water, by = "Year") |>
  arrange(Year)

# Model and predict
modN <- lm(Nitrite_and_Nitrate ~ N_percent, data = AllNutrients)
AllNutrients$NN_impute <- predict(modN, newdata = AllNutrients)

# Model summary
cat("\nNutrient imputation model (Nitrite+Nitrate ~ Tissue %N):\n")
summary(modN)
```

## 3. Benthic Cover Data

Calculate percent cover for functional groups from benthic transect surveys.

```{r benthic-processing}
#| label: process-benthic

# Read and classify benthic data
BenthicCover_Algae <- read_csv(here("Data", "raw_data", "MCR_LTER_Annual_Survey_Benthic_Cover_20251009.csv")) |>
  filter(Habitat == "Backreef")

# Create functional group classifications (vectorized)
Benthic_summary_Algae <- BenthicCover_Algae |>
  rename(name = Taxonomy_Substrate_Functional_Group) |>
  mutate(
    name = case_when(
      name %in% c(
        "Amansia rhodantha", "Turbinaria ornata", "Dictyota sp.", "Halimeda sp.",
        "Galaxaura sp.", "Liagora ceranoides", "Cyanophyta", "Halimeda minima",
        "Amphiroa fragilissima", "Caulerpa serrulata", "Corallimorpharia",
        "Dictyota friabilis", "Galaxaura rugosa", "Cladophoropsis membranacea",
        "Galaxaura filamentosa", "Halimeda discoidea", "Peyssonnelia inamoena",
        "Caulerpa racemosa", "Valonia ventricosa", "Actinotrichia fragilis",
        "Dictyota bartayresiana", "Microdictyon umbilicatum", "Halimeda distorta",
        "Halimeda incrassata", "Halimeda macroloba", "Dictyota implexa",
        "Gelidiella acerosa", "Dictyosphaeria cavernosa", "Valonia aegagropila",
        "Microdictyon okamurae", "Halimeda opuntia", "Dichotomaria obtusata",
        "Chlorodesmis fastigiata", "Phyllodictyon anastomosans", "Phormidium sp.",
        "Cladophoropsis luxurians", "Sargassum pacificum", "Chnoospora implexa",
        "Halimeda taenicola", "Boodlea kaeneana", "Padina boryana",
        "Coelothrix irregularis", "Gelidiella sp.", "Hydroclathrus clathratus",
        "Dictyota divaricata", "Hypnea spinella", "Dichotomaria marginata",
        "Sporolithon sp.", "Chaetomorpha antennina", "Asparagopsis taxiformis"
      ) ~ "Fleshy Macroalgae",
      name %in% c(
        "Algal Turf", "Damselfish Turf", "Coral Rubble",
        "Lobophora variegata", "Shell Debris", "Bare Space"
      ) ~ "Turf/Cyanobacteria",
      name %in% c(
        "Peyssonnelia bornetii", "Peyssonnelia sp.",
        "Sponge", "Tridacna sp.", "No data"
      ) ~ "Sand",
      TRUE ~ name
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(Year, Site, name) |>
  summarise(
    total_cover = sum(Percent_Cover, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_cover = 100 * total_cover / 5000,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(Site = str_replace_all(Site, "_", " "))

write_csv(Benthic_summary_Algae, here("Data", "Benthic_summary_algae.csv"))

# Calculate total calcifiers and living cover
Total_Calc <- Benthic_summary_Algae |>
  filter(name %in% c("Coral", "Crustose Corallines")) |>
  group_by(Year, Site) |>
  reframe(total_Calc = sum(mean_cover))

TotalLiving <- Benthic_summary_Algae |>
  filter(name %in% c("Coral", "Crustose Corallines", "Fleshy Macroalgae")) |>
  group_by(Year, Site) |>
  summarise(
    mean_alive = sum(mean_cover),
    mean_fleshy = sum(mean_cover[name == "Fleshy Macroalgae"], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_coral = sum(mean_cover[name == "Coral"], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## 4. Fish Biomass Data

Process fish survey data by trophic groups.

```{r fish-processing}
#| label: process-fish

# Read and process fish data
fish <- read_csv(here("Data", "raw_data", "MCR_LTER_Annual_Fish_Survey_20250324.csv"))

# Process by trophic groups (optimized filtering)
fish_summary <- fish |>
  filter(
    Site == "LTER_1",
    Habitat == "Backreef",
    Biomass < 8000, # Remove outlier sharks
    Biomass >= 0 # Remove negative (missing) values
  ) |>
  mutate(
    trophic_new = case_when(
      Fine_Trophic %in% c("Brusher", "Browser", "Excavator", "Scraper") ~ "Herbivores",
      Fine_Trophic == "Corallivore" ~ "Corallivore",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(Year, trophic_new) |>
  summarise(
    fish_g_m2 = sum(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE) / 1200, # 4 transects × 300 m²
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(fish_summary, here("Data", "fish_summary.csv"))
```

## 5. Primary Production Processing

Process raw production data and extract Pmax and Rd using Bayesian photosynthesis-irradiance curves.

```{r pp-processing}
#| label: process-pp
#| cache: true

# Read all QC PP files efficiently
filedir <- here("Data", "raw_data", "QC_PP")
files <- dir(path = filedir, pattern = ".csv", full.names = TRUE)

All_PP_data <- files |>
  set_names() |>
  map_df(read_csv, .id = "filename", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(DateTime = mdy_hm(DateTime))

# Unit conversion and data cleaning (optimized)
All_PP_data <- All_PP_data |>
  mutate(
    # Convert 2007-2014 from g O2/m2/h to mmol O2/m2/h
    across(
      c(UP_Oxy, DN_Oxy, PP),
      ~ if_else(DateTime < ymd_hms("2014-04-01 00:00:00"), (.x / 32) * 1000, .x)
    ),
    Date = as_date(DateTime),
    DielDateTime = DateTime + hours(12),
    DielDate = as_date(DielDateTime),
    Year = year(DateTime)
  ) |>
  filter(!Date %in% mdy(c("5/27/2011", "5/28/2011", "1/21/2014", "05/25/2024")))

# Keep only complete 24-hour datasets
complete_dates <- All_PP_data |>
  count(DielDate) |>
  filter(n == 24)

All_PP_data <- complete_dates |>
  left_join(All_PP_data, by = "DielDate")

# Calculate GP and environmental averages
Daily_R <- All_PP_data |>
  group_by(Year, Season, DielDate) |>
  summarise(R_average = mean(PP[PAR == 0], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

All_PP_data <- All_PP_data |>
  left_join(Daily_R, by = c("Year", "Season", "DielDate")) |>
  mutate(
    GP = if_else(PAR == 0, NA_real_, PP - R_average),
    GP = if_else(GP < 0, NA_real_, GP),
    Temperature_mean = (UP_Temp + DN_Temp) / 2,
    Flow_mean = (UP_Velocity_mps + DN_Velocity_mps) / 2
  )

# Calculate yearly averages
Year_Averages_PP <- All_PP_data |>
  mutate(
    NP = PP,
    R = if_else(PP < 0, PP, NA_real_)
  ) |>
  group_by(Year) |>
  summarise(
    NP_mean = mean(NP, na.rm = TRUE),
    NP_SE = sd(NP, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    NP_max = max(NP, na.rm = TRUE),
    GP_mean = mean(GP, na.rm = TRUE),
    GP_SE = sd(GP, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    R_mean = mean(R, na.rm = TRUE),
    R_SE = sd(R, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    Temperature_mean = mean(Temperature_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    Flow_mean = mean(Flow_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    PAR_mean = mean(PAR[PAR > 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Bayesian Photosynthesis-Irradiance (PI) Curve Analysis

We fit a Bayesian non-linear model to extract photosynthetic parameters (alpha, Pmax, and Rd) for each year. The model uses a rectangular hyperbola:

$$PP = \frac{\alpha \cdot P_{max} \cdot PAR}{\alpha \cdot PAR + P_{max}} + R_d$$

where: - $\alpha$ = initial slope (photosynthetic efficiency) - $P_{max}$ = maximum photosynthetic capacity - $R_d$ = dark respiration (ecosystem respiration) - $PAR$ = photosynthetically active radiation

```{r bayesian-pi-curve}
# Bayesian PI curves to extract light-independent Pmax and Rd
LTER1_Pnet <- All_PP_data |>
  mutate(
    tempc = Temperature_mean,
    Flowmean = Flow_mean,
    flow_log = log(Flowmean),
    UPDN = as.factor(UPDN),
    Year = as.factor(Year)
  )

# Fit Bayesian nonlinear model
fit1_f <- brm(
  bf(
    PP ~ ((alpha * Pmax * PAR) / (alpha * PAR + Pmax)) + Rd,
    nl = TRUE,
    alpha ~ 0 + Year,
    Pmax ~ 0 + Year,
    Rd ~ 0 + Year
  ) + student(),
  data = LTER1_Pnet,
  set_rescor(FALSE),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0.1, 10), nlpar = "alpha", lb = 0),
    prior(normal(-100, 10), nlpar = "Rd", ub = 0),
    prior(normal(100, 10), nlpar = "Pmax", lb = 0)
  ),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 20),
  cores = 3,
  chains = 3,
  seed = 223,
  iter = 8000,
  warmup = 2000
)

# Extract Pmax and Rd coefficients
names <- rownames(fixef(fit1_f))
coefficients <- as_tibble(fixef(fit1_f)) |>
  mutate(params = names)

PRValues <- coefficients |>
  separate(params, sep = "_", into = c("param_type", "yearname"), remove = FALSE) |>
  filter(param_type %in% c("Pmax", "Rd")) |>
  separate(yearname, sep = "r", into = c("y", "year")) |>
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year)) |>
  select(Year = year, Estimate, param_type) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = param_type, values_from = Estimate)

# Combine with raw averages
Year_Averages_PP <- Year_Averages_PP |>
  full_join(PRValues, by = "Year") |>
  mutate(Rd = -Rd) # Make Rd positive

# Calculate Bayesian R²
pi_curve_r2 <- median(bayes_R2(fit1_f)[, 1])
cat(sprintf("\nPhotosynthesis-Irradiance Curve Model:\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Bayesian R²: %.3f\n", pi_curve_r2))
cat(sprintf("  This indicates the model explains %.1f%% of variance in net production\n", pi_curve_r2 * 100))

write_csv(Year_Averages_PP, here("Data", "Year_Averages_PP.csv"))
```

## 6. Integrate All Datasets

```{r integrate-data}
#| label: integrate-datasets

# Read processed data files
Year_Averages_PP <- read_csv(here("Data", "Year_Averages_PP.csv"))
Turb <- read_csv(here("Data", "Turb_mean.csv"))
water <- read_csv(here("Data", "Water_N_mean.csv"))
insitu_temp <- read_csv(here("Data", "InSituTemp.csv"))

fish_trophic <- read_csv(here("Data", "fish_summary.csv")) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = trophic_new, values_from = fish_g_m2) |>
  select(-Other)

Benthic_summary_Algae <- read_csv(here("Data", "Benthic_summary_algae.csv"))

# Create integrated dataset
Year_Averages <- Year_Averages_PP |>
  full_join(TotalLiving |> filter(Site == "LTER 1"), by = "Year") |>
  full_join(water) |>
  full_join(Turb, by = "Year") |>
  full_join(insitu_temp, by = "Year") |>
  full_join(fish_trophic, by = "Year") |>
  mutate(log_coral = log(mean_coral)) |>
  filter(Year < 2026) |>
  arrange(Year)

# Display structure
glimpse(Year_Averages)
```

# Exploratory Data Analysis

## Benthic Community Composition

```{r benthic-plot}
#| label: fig-benthic
#| fig-cap: "Benthic community composition at LTER Site 1 (2005-2025)"
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6

# Define color palette
myPal <- c(
  Coral = "#c38370",
  `Fleshy Macroalgae` = "#99ddaa",
  `Turf/Cyanobacteria` = "#9da993",
  `Crustose Corallines` = "#523a28",
  Other = "#bdc3cb",
  Sand = "#d6ad60"
)

# Create stacked area plot
Benthic_summary_Algae |>
  mutate(name = factor(name, levels = c(
    "Coral", "Fleshy Macroalgae",
    "Crustose Corallines", "Turf/Cyanobacteria",
    "Sand", "Other"
  ))) |>
  filter(Site == "LTER 1") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = mean_cover, fill = name)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = myPal) +
  labs(
    fill = "",
    y = "% Cover",
    title = "Long-term Benthic Community Dynamics"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

**Key Observation:** Coral cover declined from `r round(Benthic_summary_Algae |> filter(Year == 2006, name == "Coral", Site == "LTER 1") |> pull(mean_cover), 1)`% in 2006 to `r round(Benthic_summary_Algae |> filter(Year == 2025, name == "Coral", Site == "LTER 1") |> pull(mean_cover), 1)`% in 2025, representing a `r round((1 - (Benthic_summary_Algae |> filter(Year == 2025, name == "Coral", Site == "LTER 1") |> pull(mean_cover)) / (Benthic_summary_Algae |> filter(Year == 2006, name == "Coral", Site == "LTER 1") |> pull(mean_cover))) * 100, 1)`% reduction.

## Ecosystem Metabolism Time Series

```{r metabolism-timeseries}
#| label: fig-metabolism
#| fig-cap: "Twenty-year time series of ecosystem metabolism showing declines in photosynthetic capacity (Pmax), respiration (Rd), and net production (NP). Points represent annual means; shaded ribbons show 95% credible intervals from Bayesian linear trend models. Pmax and Rd were extracted from Bayesian photosynthesis-irradiance curves to provide light-independent metabolic indices."
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8
#| cache: true

# Prepare data for plotting with expression labels
metabolism_data <- Year_Averages |>
  select(Year, Pmax, Rd, NP_mean) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Pmax, Rd, NP_mean), 
               names_to = "metric", 
               values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(metric_label = case_when(
    metric == "Pmax" ~ "Pmax",
    metric == "Rd" ~ "Rd",
    metric == "NP_mean" ~ "NP"
  )) |>
  mutate(metric_label = factor(metric_label, levels = c("Pmax", "Rd", "NP")))

# Create labeller function using expression notation
metric_labeller <- as_labeller(c(
  "Pmax" = "atop('Maximum Photosynthetic Capacity', paste('(mmol ', O[2], ' m'^-2, ' hr'^-1, ')'))",
  "Rd" = "atop('Ecosystem Respiration', paste('(mmol ', O[2], ' m'^-2, ' hr'^-1, ')'))",
  "NP" = "atop('Net Ecosystem Production', paste('(mmol ', O[2], ' m'^-2, ' hr'^-1, ')'))"
), default = label_parsed)

# Fit Bayesian linear models for each metric to get trend statistics
pmax_brm <- brm(Pmax ~ Year, data = Year_Averages, silent = 2, refresh = 0, seed = 223)
rd_brm <- brm(Rd ~ Year, data = Year_Averages, silent = 2, refresh = 0, seed = 223)
np_brm <- brm(NP_mean ~ Year, data = Year_Averages, silent = 2, refresh = 0, seed = 223)

# Extract trend statistics from Bayesian models
pmax_slope <- fixef(pmax_brm)["Year", "Estimate"]
pmax_ci <- fixef(pmax_brm)["Year", c("Q2.5", "Q97.5")]
rd_slope <- fixef(rd_brm)["Year", "Estimate"]
rd_ci <- fixef(rd_brm)["Year", c("Q2.5", "Q97.5")]
np_slope <- fixef(np_brm)["Year", "Estimate"]
np_ci <- fixef(np_brm)["Year", c("Q2.5", "Q97.5")]

# Calculate Bayesian R-squared
pmax_r2 <- median(bayes_R2(pmax_brm)[, 1])
rd_r2 <- median(bayes_R2(rd_brm)[, 1])
np_r2 <- median(bayes_R2(np_brm)[, 1])

# Create annotations with trend statistics using expression notation for geom_text
trend_labels <- tibble(
  metric_label = factor(c("Pmax", "Rd", "NP"), levels = c("Pmax", "Rd", "NP")),
  x = c(2008, 2008, 2008),
  y = c(Inf, Inf, Inf),
  label = c(
    sprintf("'%.2f mmol O'[2]*' m'^-2*' hr'^-1*' yr'^-1", pmax_slope),
    sprintf("'%.2f mmol O'[2]*' m'^-2*' hr'^-1*' yr'^-1", rd_slope),
    sprintf("'%.2f mmol O'[2]*' m'^-2*' hr'^-1*' yr'^-1", np_slope)
  )
)

# Create publication-quality figure
metabolism_plot <- ggplot(metabolism_data, aes(x = Year, y = value)) +
  # Add trend line with confidence interval
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",

cat(sprintf("  Bayesian R²: %.3f\n", pmax_r2))

cat("\nRd (Ecosystem Respiration):\n")

cat(sprintf("  Bayesian R²: %.3f\n", rd_r2))

cat(sprintf("  Total change (20 yr): %.1f mmol O₂ m⁻² hr⁻¹ (%.1f%%)\n", 
    rd_slope * 20, 
    (rd_slope * 20 / mean(Year_Averages$Rd, na.rm = TRUE)) * 100))

cat("\nNP (Net Ecosystem Production):\n")
cat(sprintf("  Slope: %.3f mmol O₂ m⁻² hr⁻¹ yr⁻¹ [95%% CI: %.3f, %.3f]\n",

cat(sprintf("  Bayesian R²: %.3f\n", np_r2))

    ifelse(sign(np_ci[1]) == sign(np_ci[2]), "Yes", "No")))
cat(sprintf("  Total change (20 yr): %.1f mmol O₂ m⁻² hr⁻¹\n", np_slope * 20))
```

**Key Findings:** Over the 20-year study period, all three metabolic components showed significant declines. Maximum photosynthetic capacity (Pmax) declined by `r round(pmax_slope * 20, 1)` mmol O₂ m⁻² hr⁻¹ (`r round((pmax_slope * 20 / mean(Year_Averages$Pmax, na.rm = TRUE)) * 100, 1)`%), ecosystem respiration (Rd) decreased by `r round(rd_slope * 20, 1)` mmol O₂ m⁻² hr⁻¹ (`r round((rd_slope * 20 / mean(Year_Averages$Rd, na.rm = TRUE)) * 100, 1)`%), and net ecosystem production (NP) declined by `r round(np_slope * 20, 1)` mmol O₂ m⁻² hr⁻¹. These parallel declines in both autotrophic and heterotrophic processes indicate fundamental metabolic dysfunction accompanying the coral-to-algae phase shift.

## Production/Respiration Ratio: Ecosystem Maturity Indicator

```{r pr-ratio}
#| label: fig-pr-ratio
#| fig-cap: "Production to Respiration (P/R) ratio over time. Values >1 indicate net autotrophy (production exceeds respiration), while values <1 indicate net heterotrophy. Odum (1969) proposed P/R as an indicator of ecosystem maturity, with mature systems approaching P/R = 1. The increasing trend away from 1 reflects disproportionate loss of respiratory capacity (coral biomass) relative to production."
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 3

# Calculate P/R ratio
Year_Averages <- Year_Averages |>
  mutate(P_R_ratio = Pmax / Rd)

# Fit Bayesian model for P/R ratio trend
pr_brm <- brm(P_R_ratio ~ Year, data = Year_Averages, silent = 2, refresh = 0, seed = 223)

# Extract coefficients
pr_slope <- fixef(pr_brm)["Year", "Estimate"]
pr_ci <- fixef(pr_brm)["Year", c("Q2.5", "Q97.5")]
pr_r2 <- median(bayes_R2(pr_brm)[, 1])

# Create plot
pr_plot <- ggplot(Year_Averages, aes(x = Year, y = P_R_ratio)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray30", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE,
    color = "#7570B3",
    fill = "#7570B3",
    alpha = 0.15,
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "#7570B3", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(color = "#7570B3", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.4) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 2008, y = Inf,
    label = sprintf("%.3f yr⁻¹ [95%% CI: %.3f, %.3f]\nBayesian R² = %.2f",
                    pr_slope, pr_ci[1], pr_ci[2], pr_r2),
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1.2,
    size = 4.5, color = "gray30"
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = 2024, y = 1.05, label = "Net Autotrophy (P > R)", 
           hjust = 1, size = 4, color = "gray40") +
  annotate("text", x = 2024, y = 0.95, label = "Net Heterotrophy (P < R)", 
           hjust = 1, size = 4, color = "gray40") +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "P/R Ratio (Pmax / Rd)",
    title = "Ecosystem Maturity Decline: Production/Respiration Ratio",
    subtitle = "Increasing P/R (moving away from 1) indicates loss of respiratory biomass"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 13),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 17, face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 5)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, color = "gray40", margin = margin(b = 15))
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2007, 2025, by = 3),
                     minor_breaks = seq(2007, 2025, by = 1),
                     limits = c(2007, 2025))

pr_plot

# Print summary
cat("\n=== P/R Ratio Analysis ===\n\n")
cat(sprintf("Initial P/R (2008-2010): %.2f ± %.2f\n",
            mean(Year_Averages$P_R_ratio[Year_Averages$Year %in% 2008:2010], na.rm = TRUE),
            sd(Year_Averages$P_R_ratio[Year_Averages$Year %in% 2008:2010], na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("Recent P/R (2023-2025): %.2f ± %.2f\n",
            mean(Year_Averages$P_R_ratio[Year_Averages$Year %in% 2023:2025], na.rm = TRUE),
            sd(Year_Averages$P_R_ratio[Year_Averages$Year %in% 2023:2025], na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("Slope: %.4f yr⁻¹ [95%% CI: %.4f, %.4f]\n", pr_slope, pr_ci[1], pr_ci[2]))
cat(sprintf("Total change: %.2f over 20 years\n", pr_slope * 20))
cat(sprintf("Bayesian R²: %.3f\n", pr_r2))
cat("\nInterpretation: P/R ratio increasing from ~%.1f to ~%.1f indicates shift away\n",
    mean(Year_Averages$P_R_ratio[Year_Averages$Year %in% 2008:2010], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(Year_Averages$P_R_ratio[Year_Averages$Year %in% 2023:2025], na.rm = TRUE))
cat("from mature ecosystem balance. The higher P/R reflects disproportionate loss of\n")
cat("respiratory biomass (coral holobiont) while production remains—ecosystem retrogression\n")
cat("through loss of high-biomass, high-metabolism structure (sensu Odum 1969).\n")
```

**Ecosystem Maturity Decline**: The P/R ratio provides an integrative measure of ecosystem development (Odum 1969). Mature ecosystems approach P/R ≈ 1, balancing production and respiration with high biomass and efficient nutrient cycling. The observed increase in P/R from `r round(mean(Year_Averages$P_R_ratio[Year_Averages$Year %in% 2008:2010], na.rm = TRUE), 2)` to `r round(mean(Year_Averages$P_R_ratio[Year_Averages$Year %in% 2023:2025], na.rm = TRUE), 2)` represents ecosystem retrogression through disproportionate loss of respiratory capacity. While mature coral reefs maintain P/R ≈ 1 through high biomass and tight metabolic coupling, the increasing P/R indicates loss of the high-respiration coral holobiont while production (largely from algae) persists, creating metabolic imbalance characteristic of degraded systems.

```{r gp-r-ratio}
            mean(Year_Averages$P_R_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),

```

**GP/R vs Pmax/R Comparison**: The GP/R ratio (mean: `r round(mean(Year_Averages$GP_R_ratio, na.rm = TRUE), 2)`) is consistently lower than Pmax/R (mean: `r round(mean(Year_Averages$P_R_ratio, na.rm = TRUE), 2)`) because gross production integrates over full daily light cycles including dawn, dusk, and night periods, while Pmax represents maximum photosynthetic capacity under light saturation. The ratio of these two metrics (`r round(mean(Year_Averages$P_R_ratio, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(Year_Averages$GP_R_ratio, na.rm = TRUE), 1)`:1) indicates the degree to which the ecosystem operates below its photosynthetic potential under natural light regimes. Both metrics show similar temporal trends, confirming that metabolic imbalance is occurring at both potential and realized levels of ecosystem function.

# Statistical Analysis

## Temporal Trends

Assess standardized change per year using Bayesian linear models.

```{r temporal-trends}
#| label: temporal-trends
#| cache: true

# Create standardized dataset
std_data <- Year_Averages |>
  select(
    mean_coral, mean_fleshy, Pmax, Rd, N_percent,
    Herbivores, Corallivore, NP_mean, Max_temp, GP_mean,
    Nitrite_and_Nitrate, Phosphate
  ) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)))) |>
  bind_cols(Year_Averages |> select(Year))

# Fit Bayesian models for each variable and extract R²
fit_temporal_model <- function(response_var, param_name) {
  form <- as.formula(paste(response_var, "~ Year"))
  mod <- brm(form, data = std_data, silent = 2, refresh = 0, seed = 223)
  
  # Extract posterior samples
  post <- as_tibble(as.matrix(mod)) |>
    select(Year = b_Year) |>
    mutate(Parameter = param_name)
  
  # Calculate Bayesian R²
  r2 <- median(bayes_R2(mod)[, 1])
  
  # Store model for later R² extraction
  list(posterior = post, model = mod, r2 = r2, param = param_name)
}

# Fit all models
temporal_models <- list(
  fit_temporal_model("mean_coral", "% Coral Cover"),
  fit_temporal_model("mean_fleshy", "% Macroalgae Cover"),
  fit_temporal_model("Corallivore", "Corallivore"),
  fit_temporal_model("Herbivores", "Herbivore/bioeroding fish"),
  fit_temporal_model("N_percent", "%N Content"),
  fit_temporal_model("Rd", "Ecosystem Respiration"),
  fit_temporal_model("Pmax", "Maximum Photosynthetic Capacity"),
  fit_temporal_model("NP_mean", "Net Ecosystem Production"),
  fit_temporal_model("Max_temp", "Max Temperature"),
  fit_temporal_model("Nitrite_and_Nitrate", "Nitrate + Nitrite")
)

# Extract posteriors for plotting
temporal_results <- temporal_models |>
  map_df(~.x$posterior)

# Print R² values
cat("\n=== Temporal Trend Model Performance (Bayesian R²) ===\n\n")
temporal_models |>
  map_df(~tibble(Parameter = .x$param, R2 = .x$r2)) |>
  arrange(desc(R2)) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r temporal-plot}
#| label: fig-temporal
#| fig-cap: "Standardized temporal trends and raw time-series for 10 reef ecosystem
#|   variables. (a) Posterior distributions of the standardized slope (change per year)
#|   from Bayesian linear models; vertical dashed line at zero; white tick marks indicate
#|   95% credible intervals. (b) Raw annual observations (points) with posterior median
#|   trendline and 95% credible interval ribbon on original measurement scales. Units:
#|   coral and macroalgae cover (%); fish biomass (g m\u207b\u00b2); N content (%);
#|   ecosystem metabolism (mmol O\u2082 m\u207b\u00b2 hr\u207b\u00b9); temperature (\u00b0C);
#|   nitrate+nitrite (\u00b5mol L\u207b\u00b9). Colour encodes direction: red = increasing,
#|   blue = decreasing."
#| fig-width: 8.9
#| fig-height: 7.5

library(patchwork)
library(showtext)
library(sysfonts)

# Noto Sans has full Unicode coverage (superscripts, µ, °, subscripts)
# Falls back gracefully if offline — font is cached after first download
font_add_google("Noto Sans", family = "noto")
showtext_auto(enable = TRUE)

# ── Nature-ready base theme (7 pt, classic, no gridlines) ──────────────────
theme_nature <- function(base_size = 7) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      text             = element_text(family = "noto"),
      axis.text        = element_text(size = base_size, color = "black"),
      axis.title       = element_text(size = base_size + 0.5),
      axis.line        = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks       = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, color = "black"),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text       = element_text(size = 6.5, face = "plain", color = "grey20"),
      panel.spacing    = unit(0.5, "lines"),
      legend.position  = "none",
      plot.tag         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9)
    )
}

col_inc <- "#E64B35"   # NPG red  — increasing
col_dec <- "#4DBBD5"   # NPG teal — decreasing

# ── Summarise posterior slopes (order + color mapping) ─────────────────────
slope_summary <- temporal_results |>
  group_by(Parameter) |>
  summarise(
    median_slope = median(Year),
    direction    = if_else(median_slope > 0, "Increasing", "Decreasing"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(median_slope)

param_levels <- slope_summary$Parameter

# Short names for panel a y-axis (strip units line from panel b labels)
short_name_map <- scale_params |>
  select(Parameter, label) |>
  mutate(short_name = str_remove(label, "\n.*"))

# ── Panel a: Posterior density ridges ──────────────────────────────────────
panel_a <- temporal_results |>
  left_join(slope_summary |> select(Parameter, direction), by = "Parameter") |>
  left_join(short_name_map, by = "Parameter") |>
  mutate(short_name = factor(short_name, levels = short_name_map$short_name[match(param_levels, short_name_map$Parameter)])) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = short_name, fill = direction)) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.35, color = "grey55"
  ) +
  stat_density_ridges(
    quantile_lines = TRUE, quantiles = c(0.025, 0.975),
    alpha = 0.75, linewidth = 0.25, color = "white",
    scale = 0.88, rel_min_height = 0.01
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Increasing" = col_inc, "Decreasing" = col_dec)) +
  annotate("text", x =  0.06, y = 0.6, label = "Increasing \u2192",
           hjust = 0, size = 1.9, color = col_inc, fontface = "italic", family = "noto") +
  annotate("text", x = -0.06, y = 0.6, label = "\u2190 Decreasing",
           hjust = 1, size = 1.9, color = col_dec, fontface = "italic", family = "noto") +
  labs(x = "Standardized change per year", y = NULL, tag = "a") +
  lims(x = c(-0.35, 0.35)) +
  theme_nature() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6.5))

# ── Back-transform fitted values and raw data to original scales ────────────
# Scale parameters (mean + SD) from unscaled Year_Averages
short_label_map <- tibble(
  var = c("mean_coral", "mean_fleshy", "Corallivore", "Herbivores",
          "N_percent", "Rd", "Pmax", "NP_mean", "Max_temp", "Nitrite_and_Nitrate"),
  Parameter = c("% Coral Cover", "% Macroalgae Cover", "Corallivore",
                "Herbivore/bioeroding fish", "%N Content", "Ecosystem Respiration",
                "Maximum Photosynthetic Capacity", "Net Ecosystem Production",
                "Max Temperature", "Nitrate + Nitrite"),
  label = c(
    "Coral cover\n(%)",
    "Macroalgae cover\n(%)",
    "Corallivore\n(g m\u207b\u00b2)",
    "Herbivores\n(g m\u207b\u00b2)",
    "N content\n(%)",
    "Respiration\n(mmol O\u2082 m\u207b\u00b2 hr\u207b\u00b9)",
    "Pmax\n(mmol O\u2082 m\u207b\u00b2 hr\u207b\u00b9)",
    "NEP\n(mmol O\u2082 m\u207b\u00b2 hr\u207b\u00b9)",
    "Max temperature\n(\u00b0C)",
    "Nitrate+nitrite\n(\u00b5mol L\u207b\u00b9)"
  )
)

scale_params <- tibble(
  var = short_label_map$var,
  mu  = map_dbl(short_label_map$var, ~mean(Year_Averages[[.x]], na.rm = TRUE)),
  sd  = map_dbl(short_label_map$var, ~sd(Year_Averages[[.x]],   na.rm = TRUE))
) |>
  left_join(short_label_map, by = "var")

label_levels <- scale_params$label[match(param_levels, scale_params$Parameter)]

# ── Extract fitted values + raw data from each Bayesian model ───────────────
get_time_series <- function(model_obj) {
  mod      <- model_obj$model
  param    <- model_obj$param
  resp_var <- as.character(formula(mod)$formula)[2]
  year_seq <- tibble(Year = seq(min(std_data$Year), max(std_data$Year), by = 0.5))
  fitted_df <- fitted(mod, newdata = year_seq) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    bind_cols(year_seq) |>
    mutate(Parameter = param)
  raw_df <- std_data |>
    select(Year, value = all_of(resp_var)) |>
    mutate(Parameter = param)
  list(fitted = fitted_df, raw = raw_df)
}

all_series <- map(temporal_models, get_time_series)

fitted_all <- map_df(all_series, ~.x$fitted) |>
  left_join(slope_summary |> select(Parameter, direction), by = "Parameter") |>
  left_join(scale_params |> select(Parameter, mu, sd, label), by = "Parameter") |>
  mutate(
    Estimate_orig = Estimate * sd + mu,
    Q2.5_orig     = Q2.5    * sd + mu,
    Q97.5_orig    = Q97.5   * sd + mu,
    label = factor(label, levels = label_levels)
  )

raw_all <- map_df(all_series, ~.x$raw) |>
  left_join(slope_summary |> select(Parameter, direction), by = "Parameter") |>
  left_join(scale_params |> select(Parameter, mu, sd, label), by = "Parameter") |>
  mutate(
    value_orig = value * sd + mu,
    label = factor(label, levels = label_levels)
  )

# ── Bayesian R² annotations ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
r2_df <- map_df(temporal_models, ~tibble(Parameter = .x$param, r2 = .x$r2)) |>
  left_join(scale_params |> select(Parameter, label), by = "Parameter") |>
  mutate(
    label    = factor(label, levels = label_levels),
    r2_label = paste0("R\u00b2 = ", round(r2, 2))
  )

# ── Panel b: Small-multiple time series on original scale ───────────────────
panel_b <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = fitted_all,
    aes(x = Year, ymin = Q2.5_orig, ymax = Q97.5_orig, fill = direction),
    alpha = 0.18
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = fitted_all,
    aes(x = Year, y = Estimate_orig, color = direction),
    linewidth = 0.55
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = raw_all,
    aes(x = Year, y = value_orig),
    size = 0.85, alpha = 0.70, shape = 16, color = "grey25"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = r2_df,
    aes(label = r2_label),
    x = -Inf, y = Inf,
    hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.4,
    size = 1.8, color = "grey45", fontface = "italic", family = "noto"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~label, scales = "free_y", ncol = 5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("Increasing" = col_inc, "Decreasing" = col_dec)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Increasing" = col_inc, "Decreasing" = col_dec)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2008, 2014, 2020)) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = NULL, tag = "b") +
  theme_nature() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 5.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5.5)
  )

# ── Combine and render ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig7 <- panel_a / panel_b +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1.05, 1.4)) &
  theme(plot.background = element_blank())

fig7

ggsave(
  here("Output", "fig7_temporal_trends.pdf"),
  plot   = fig7,
  width  = 183,
  height = 155,
  units  = "mm",
  device = cairo_pdf
)
```

**Model Performance Summary**: The Bayesian temporal trend models showed varying explanatory power across ecosystem variables. Temperature and coral cover trends had the highest R² values (>0.5), indicating highly predictable linear trajectories over time. Metabolic variables (Pmax, Rd, NP) showed moderate explanatory power (R² = 0.2-0.5), reflecting both directional trends and substantial year-to-year variability. Fish biomass trends had lower R² values, suggesting additional drivers beyond benthic habitat changes influence these populations.

## Percent Change Analysis

```{r percent-change}
#| label: fig-percent-change
#| fig-cap: "Percent change from start to end of time series"
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6

# Helper functions for first/last non-NA values
get_first_non_na <- function(x) {
  x[which(!is.na(x))[1]]
}

get_last_non_na <- function(x) {
  non_na <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(non_na) > 0) tail(non_na, 1) else NA
}

# Calculate percent changes
change_data <- Year_Averages |>
  select(
    NP_mean, mean_fleshy, mean_coral, Pmax, Rd,
    N_percent, Herbivores, Corallivore, Max_temp, Nitrite_and_Nitrate
  ) |>
  summarise(across(everything(), list(
    first = get_first_non_na,
    last = get_last_non_na
  ))) |>
  pivot_longer(everything()) %>%
  separate(col = name, into = c("Params", "stat"), sep = "_(?=first|last)", remove = TRUE) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = value) |>
  mutate(
    percent_change = (last - first) / first * 100,
    percent_change = if_else(Params == "NP_mean", -percent_change, percent_change)
  ) |>
  mutate(nicenames = case_when(
    Params == "mean_fleshy" ~ "% Macroalgae Cover",
    Params == "NP_mean" ~ "Net Ecosystem Production",
    Params == "Max_temp" ~ "Max Temperature",
    Params == "Herbivores" ~ "Herbivore/bioeroding fish",
    Params == "Corallivore" ~ "Corallivore",
    Params == "Pmax" ~ "Maximum Photosynthetic Capacity",
    Params == "N_percent" ~ "%N Content",
    Params == "Rd" ~ "Ecosystem Respiration",
    Params == "mean_coral" ~ "% Coral Cover",
    Params == "Nitrite_and_Nitrate" ~ "Nitrate + Nitrite"
  )) |>
  arrange(desc(percent_change))

# Calculate rates per year for annotation
meanyearmodels <- Year_Averages |>
  select(change_data$Params) |>
  summarise(across(everything(), mean, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Params", values_to = "Mean")

sdyearmodels <- Year_Averages |>
  select(change_data$Params) |>
  summarise(across(everything(), sd, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Params", values_to = "SD")

Rates <- meanyearmodels |>
  left_join(sdyearmodels, by = "Params") |>
  mutate(nicenames = case_when(
    Params == "mean_coral" ~ "% Coral Cover",
    Params == "mean_fleshy" ~ "% Macroalgae Cover",
    Params == "N_percent" ~ "%N Content",
    Params == "Corallivore" ~ "Corallivore",
    Params == "Rd" ~ "Ecosystem Respiration",
    Params == "Herbivores" ~ "Herbivore/bioeroding fish",
    Params == "Max_temp" ~ "Max Temperature",
    Params == "Pmax" ~ "Maximum Photosynthetic Capacity",
    Params == "NP_mean" ~ "Net Ecosystem Production",
    Params == "Nitrite_and_Nitrate" ~ "Nitrate + Nitrite"
  )) |>
  drop_na() |>
  left_join(
    temporal_results |>
      group_by(Parameter) |>
      summarise(Rate = median(Year)),
    by = c("nicenames" = "Parameter")
  ) |>
  mutate(Rate_Year = round(Rate * SD, 2))

# Lollipop plot
change_data |>
  mutate(
    nicenames = factor(nicenames, levels = rev(unique(change_data$nicenames))),
    color = if_else(percent_change > 0, "pos", "neg")
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = percent_change, y = nicenames)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = percent_change, yend = nicenames), linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(aes(color = color), size = 4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  geom_text(data = Rates, aes(x = -120, y = nicenames, label = Rate_Year), size = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#B22222", "#22B2B2")) +
  labs(
    x = "Percent change over time series (%)",
    y = "",
    title = "Ecosystem Change Magnitudes",
    subtitle = "Numbers on left show annual rate of change in original units"
  ) +
  lims(x = c(-130, 185)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14)
  )
```

## Structural Equation Modeling

Fit a Bayesian SEM to understand causal pathways among ecosystem components.

```{r sem-prep}
#| label: sem-preparation

# Calculate year residuals (disturbances beyond temperature)
yearresid <- resid(lm(Year ~ Max_temp, data = Year_Averages, na.action = na.pass))

# Prepare scaled SEM data
semdata2 <- Year_Averages |>
  mutate(
    logfleshy = log(mean_fleshy),
    logrd = log(Rd),
    logpmax = log(Pmax),
    logproducers = log(mean_alive),
    N_percent = log(N_percent),
    yearresid = yearresid
  ) |>
  select(
    Year, meancoral = mean_coral, logproducers, meanfleshy = mean_fleshy,
    temperature = Max_temp, flow = Flow_mean, Npercent = N_percent,
    logrd, logpmax, logcoral = log_coral, logfleshy, Corallivore,
    herbs = Herbivores, yearresid
  ) |>
  drop_na(logcoral) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x))))
```

```{r sem-fit}
#| label: sem-model
#| cache: true

# Define SEM structure
bf_temp <- bf(temperature | mi() ~ 1 + Year)
bf_coraltemp <- bf(logcoral | trunc(ub = 3.39) ~ 1 + temperature #+ yearresid
                   )
bf_logpmax <- bf(logpmax | mi() ~ 1 + logcoral + mi(temperature) + mi(logrd)) ####
bf_logrd <- bf(logrd | mi() ~ 1 + logcoral + mi(temperature))
bf_herbs <- bf(herbs | mi() ~ 1 + logfleshy)
bf_corallivore <- bf(Corallivore | mi() ~ 1 + logcoral)
bf_fleshy <- bf(logfleshy | trunc(ub = 2.26) ~ logcoral)
bf_nutrients <- bf(Npercent | mi() ~ 1 + mi(logrd))

# Fit full SEM
brms_sem_full <- brm(
  bf_temp + bf_coraltemp + bf_logrd + bf_herbs + bf_corallivore +
    bf_nutrients + bf_fleshy + bf_logpmax + set_rescor(FALSE),
  data = semdata2,
  chains = 3,
  iter = 10000,
  warmup = 5000,
  seed = 11,
  sample_prior = "no",
  prior = c(
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "b"),
    set_prior("normal(0, 0.25)", resp = "temperature", class = "sigma", lb = 0),
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "Intercept")
  ),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15),
  family = gaussian(),
  silent = 2,
  refresh = 0
)
```

```{r sem-summary}
#| label: sem-results

summary(brms_sem_full)
```

```{r}
#| label: sem-r2-calculation

# Calculate Bayesian R² for each response variable in the SEM
# Note: Some responses with missing data imputation may have NaN - filter these out
sem_r2 <- bayes_R2(brms_sem_full, summary = FALSE)
sem_r2_summary <- apply(sem_r2, 2, median, na.rm = TRUE)

# Remove NaN values
sem_r2_valid <- sem_r2_summary[!is.na(sem_r2_summary)]

cat("\n=== Structural Equation Model: Bayesian R² by Response ===\n\n")
sem_r2_df <- tibble(
  Response = names(sem_r2_valid),
  R2 = sem_r2_valid
) |>
  mutate(Response = case_when(
    Response == "R2temperature" ~ "Temperature",
    Response == "R2logcoral" ~ "Coral Cover",
    Response == "R2logpmax" ~ "Ecosystem Pmax",
    Response == "R2logrd" ~ "Ecosystem Rd",
    Response == "R2herbs" ~ "Herbivorous Fish",
    Response == "R2Corallivore" ~ "Corallivore Fish",
    Response == "R2logfleshy" ~ "Fleshy Macroalgae",
    Response == "R2Npercent" ~ "N Content",
    TRUE ~ Response
  )) |>
  arrange(desc(R2))

print(sem_r2_df, n = Inf)

cat("\n")
cat(sprintf("Mean R² across computable responses: %.3f\n", mean(sem_r2_valid)))
cat(sprintf("The SEM explains between %.1f%% and %.1f%% of variance across responses.\n",
            min(sem_r2_valid) * 100, max(sem_r2_valid) * 100))
cat("Note: R² not computed for responses with extensive missing data imputation.\n")
```

## SEM Conceptual Model

```{r sem-dag}
#| label: fig-sem-dag
#| fig-cap: "Causal pathways in the Bayesian SEM. Arrow width is proportional to the standardized path coefficient (|β|); blue = positive effect, red = negative effect; gray = 95% credible interval crosses zero."
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7

pos_col  <- "#1565C0"
neg_col  <- "#B71C1C"
nsig_col <- "#AAAAAA"

dag_nodes <- tribble(
  ~id,           ~label,                    ~x,     ~y,    ~fill,       ~border,
  "Year",        "Year",                     0,     3.0,   "white",     "#888888",
  "Temp",        "Temperature",              2.2,   3.0,   "white",     "#888888",
  "Coral",       "Coral\nCover",             4.5,   3.0,   "#E8F5E9",   "#2E7D32",
  "Algae",       "Fleshy\nAlgae",            7.2,   5.2,   "#E8F5E9",   "#2E7D32",
  "Rd",          "Ecosystem\nRespiration",   7.2,   3.0,   "#EDE7F6",   "#4527A0",
  "Pmax",        "Ecosystem\nGPP",           7.2,   0.8,   "#EDE7F6",   "#4527A0",
  "N",           "Algal N\nContent",        10.0,   3.0,   "#FFF8E1",   "#E65100",
  "Corallivore", "Corallivore\nFish",        9.8,   4.5,   "#E3F2FD",   "#0D47A1",
  "Herbs",       "Herbivore\nFish",         10.0,   5.2,   "#E3F2FD",   "#0D47A1"
)

dag_edges <- tribble(
  ~from,   ~to,           ~est,   ~sig,  ~loff_x, ~loff_y,
  "Year",  "Temp",        0.462,  TRUE,   0.0,     0.25,
  "Temp",  "Coral",      -0.558,  TRUE,   0.0,     0.25,
  "Temp",  "Rd",          0.214,  FALSE,  0.0,     0.0,
  "Temp",  "Pmax",       -0.158,  FALSE,  0.0,     0.0,
  "Coral", "Algae",      -0.914,  TRUE,  -0.3,     0.0,
  "Coral", "Rd",          1.080,  TRUE,   0.0,     0.30,
  "Coral", "Corallivore", 0.645,  TRUE,   0.2,     0.2,
  "Coral", "Pmax",       -0.353,  FALSE, -0.3,     0.0,
  "Rd",    "N",           0.623,  TRUE,   0.0,     0.30,
  "Rd",    "Pmax",        0.819,  TRUE,  -0.30,    0.0,
  "Algae", "Herbs",       0.711,  TRUE,   0.0,     0.30
) |>
  mutate(
    direction = if_else(est >= 0, "pos", "neg"),
    abs_est   = abs(est)
  ) |>
  left_join(dag_nodes |> select(id, x, y) |> rename(from = id, x0 = x, y0 = y), by = "from") |>
  left_join(dag_nodes |> select(id, x, y) |> rename(to   = id, x1 = x, y1 = y), by = "to") |>
  mutate(mx = (x0 + x1) / 2, my = (y0 + y1) / 2, lbl = sprintf("%.2f", est))

dag_straight    <- dag_edges |> filter(!(from == "Temp" & to %in% c("Rd", "Pmax")))
dag_curved_rd   <- dag_edges |> filter(from == "Temp", to == "Rd")
dag_curved_pmax <- dag_edges |> filter(from == "Temp", to == "Pmax")

dag_arr <- arrow(length = unit(3.5, "mm"), type = "closed")

ggplot() +
  geom_segment(data = filter(dag_straight,  sig),
    aes(x = x0, y = y0, xend = x1, yend = y1, color = direction, linewidth = abs_est),
    alpha = 0.82, arrow = dag_arr, lineend = "butt") +
  geom_segment(data = filter(dag_straight, !sig),
    aes(x = x0, y = y0, xend = x1, yend = y1, linewidth = abs_est),
    color = nsig_col, alpha = 0.70, arrow = dag_arr, lineend = "butt") +
  geom_label(data = filter(dag_straight,  sig),
    aes(x = mx + loff_x, y = my + loff_y, label = lbl, color = direction),
    size = 3.0, fontface = "bold", fill = "white",
    label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(0.10, "lines"), show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_label(data = filter(dag_straight, !sig),
    aes(x = mx + loff_x, y = my + loff_y, label = lbl),
    color = nsig_col, size = 3.0, fontface = "bold", fill = "white",
    label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(0.10, "lines"), show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_curve(data = dag_curved_rd,
    aes(x = x0, y = y0, xend = x1, yend = y1, linewidth = abs_est),
    color = nsig_col, alpha = 0.70, curvature = -0.28, arrow = dag_arr, lineend = "butt") +
  geom_label(data = dag_curved_rd,
    aes(x = mx + 0.3, y = my + 0.85, label = lbl),
    color = nsig_col, size = 3.0, fontface = "bold", fill = "white",
    label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(0.10, "lines"), show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_curve(data = dag_curved_pmax,
    aes(x = x0, y = y0, xend = x1, yend = y1, linewidth = abs_est),
    color = nsig_col, alpha = 0.70, curvature = 0.30, arrow = dag_arr, lineend = "butt") +
  geom_label(data = dag_curved_pmax,
    aes(x = mx - 0.1, y = my - 0.85, label = lbl),
    color = nsig_col, size = 3.0, fontface = "bold", fill = "white",
    label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(0.10, "lines"), show.legend = FALSE) +
  {lapply(seq_len(nrow(dag_nodes)), function(i) {
    nd <- dag_nodes[i, ]
    geom_label(data = nd, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
               fill = nd$fill, color = nd$border, size = 3.2,
               fontface = "bold", lineheight = 0.9, label.size = 0.75,
               label.padding = unit(0.45, "lines"), label.r = unit(5, "pt"),
               show.legend = FALSE)
  })} +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("pos" = pos_col, "neg" = neg_col),
                     labels = c("pos" = "Positive", "neg" = "Negative"),
                     name = "Effect direction") +
  scale_linewidth(range = c(0.8, 3.2), guide = "none") +
  labs(caption = "Standardized β on arrows  ·  gray = 95% CI crosses zero") +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.caption    = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey55", size = 9, margin = margin(t = 8)),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.margin     = margin(15, 20, 10, 20)
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.5))) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.5, 11.5), ylim = c(-0.3, 6.3))
```

## SEM Path Coefficients

```{r sem-paths}
#| label: fig-sem-paths
#| fig-cap: "Standardized effect sizes from structural equation model"
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 6

# Extract and format path coefficients
gp_edges <- as_tibble(fixef(brms_sem_full)) |>
  mutate(coef = rownames(fixef(brms_sem_full))) |>
  separate(col = coef, into = c("resp", "pred")) |>
  filter(pred != "Intercept") |>
  rename(est = Estimate, lo = `Q2.5`, hi = `Q97.5`) |>
  mutate(sig = if_else(sign(lo) == sign(hi), 1, 0.5)) |>
  mutate(resp = case_when(
    resp == "temperature" ~ "Temperature",
    resp == "logfleshy" ~ "Fleshy Macroalgae",
    resp == "logpmax" ~ "Ecosystem Pmax",
    resp == "logrd" ~ "Ecosystem Rd",
    resp == "herbs" ~ "Herbivorous Fish",
    resp == "Corallivore" ~ "Corallivore Fish",
    resp == "logcoral" ~ "Coral",
    resp == "Npercent" ~ "N stock"
  )) |>
  mutate(resp = factor(resp, c(
    "Temperature", "Coral", "Fleshy Macroalgae", "Herbivorous Fish",
    "Corallivore Fish", "Ecosystem Rd", "Ecosystem Pmax", "N stock"
  ))) |>
  mutate(pred = case_when(
    pred == "temperature" ~ "Temperature",
    pred == "mitemperature" ~ "Temperature",
    pred == "logproducers" ~ "Total Producer Cover",
    pred == "milogrd" ~ "Ecosystem Rd Rate",
    pred == "logcoral" ~ "Coral Cover",
    pred == "logfleshy" ~ "Fleshy Macroalgae Cover",
    pred == "Year" ~ "Year",
    pred == "yearresid" ~ "Non-Temperature Yearly Variability"
  )) |>
  mutate(pred = factor(pred, c(
    "Ecosystem Rd Rate", "Total Producer Cover",
    "Fleshy Macroalgae Cover", "Coral Cover", "Non-Temperature Yearly Variability",
    "Temperature", "Year"
  )))

gp_edges |>
  ggplot(aes(x = est, y = pred)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "firebrick", aes(alpha = sig)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi, alpha = sig), height = 0, color = "firebrick") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  scale_alpha(range = c(0.25, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Standardized Effect Size",
    y = "Predictor Variables",
    title = "SEM Path Coefficients"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~resp, nrow = 1) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

## Temperature Effects: Direct vs Indirect

Calculate the total, direct, and indirect effects of temperature on all ecosystem responses.

```{r temp-effects}
#| label: fig-temp-effects
#| fig-cap: "Direct and indirect effects of temperature on ecosystem components"
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8
#| cache: true

# Extract posterior samples for path coefficients
post_samples <- as_tibble(as.matrix(brms_sem_full))

# Calculate indirect effects of temperature through coral cover
# Temperature -> Coral -> [Response]

# Direct effects (already in the model)
# Temperature -> Coral
temp_to_coral <- post_samples$b_logcoral_temperature

# Temperature -> Pmax
temp_to_pmax <- post_samples$bsp_logpmax_mitemperature

# Temperature -> Rd
temp_to_rd <- post_samples$bsp_logrd_mitemperature

# Indirect effects through coral
# Coral -> Pmax
coral_to_pmax <- post_samples$b_logpmax_logcoral

# Coral -> Rd
coral_to_rd <- post_samples$b_logrd_logcoral

# Coral -> Fleshy Algae
coral_to_fleshy <- post_samples$b_logfleshy_logcoral

# Coral -> Corallivores
coral_to_corallivore <- post_samples$b_Corallivore_logcoral

# Fleshy Algae -> Herbivores
fleshy_to_herbs <- post_samples$b_herbs_logfleshy

# Rd -> N content
rd_to_n <- post_samples$bsp_Npercent_milogrd

# Calculate total and indirect effects
effects_data <- tibble(
  # Coral (direct only)
  response = c("Coral Cover", "Coral Cover",
               # Pmax (direct + indirect through coral)
               "Ecosystem Pmax", "Ecosystem Pmax",
               # Rd (direct + indirect through coral)
               "Ecosystem Rd", "Ecosystem Rd",
               # Fleshy Algae (indirect through coral)
               "Fleshy Macroalgae", "Fleshy Macroalgae",
               # Corallivores (indirect through coral)
               "Corallivore Fish", "Corallivore Fish",
               # Herbivores (indirect through coral -> algae)
               "Herbivore Fish", "Herbivore Fish",
               # N content (indirect through coral -> Rd)
               "N Content", "N Content"),
  
  effect_type = rep(c("Direct", "Indirect"), 7),
  
  samples = list(
    # Coral
    temp_to_coral,  # Direct
    rep(0, length(temp_to_coral)),  # No indirect (coral is first response)
    
    # Pmax
    temp_to_pmax,  # Direct
    temp_to_coral * coral_to_pmax,  # Indirect: Temp -> Coral -> Pmax
    
    # Rd
    temp_to_rd,  # Direct
    temp_to_coral * coral_to_rd,  # Indirect: Temp -> Coral -> Rd
    
    # Fleshy Algae
    rep(0, length(temp_to_coral)),  # No direct effect
    temp_to_coral * coral_to_fleshy,  # Indirect: Temp -> Coral -> Algae
    
    # Corallivores
    rep(0, length(temp_to_coral)),  # No direct effect
    temp_to_coral * coral_to_corallivore,  # Indirect: Temp -> Coral -> Corallivore
    
    # Herbivores
    rep(0, length(temp_to_coral)),  # No direct effect
    temp_to_coral * coral_to_fleshy * fleshy_to_herbs,  # Indirect: Temp -> Coral -> Algae -> Herbs
    
    # N content
    rep(0, length(temp_to_coral)),  # No direct effect
    temp_to_coral * coral_to_rd * rd_to_n  # Indirect: Temp -> Coral -> Rd -> N
  )
)

# Calculate summary statistics for each effect
effects_summary <- effects_data |>
  mutate(
    median = map_dbl(samples, median),
    lower = map_dbl(samples, ~quantile(.x, 0.025)),
    upper = map_dbl(samples, ~quantile(.x, 0.975)),
    significant = map_lgl(samples, ~sign(quantile(.x, 0.025)) == sign(quantile(.x, 0.975)))
  ) |>
  mutate(response = factor(response, levels = c(
    "Coral Cover", "Fleshy Macroalgae", "Herbivore Fish",
    "Corallivore Fish", "Ecosystem Rd", "Ecosystem Pmax", "N Content"
  )))

# Calculate total effects
total_effects <- effects_summary |>
  select(response, effect_type, samples) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = effect_type, values_from = samples) |>
  mutate(Total = map2(Direct, Indirect, ~.x + .y)) |>
  select(response, Total) |>
  mutate(
    effect_type = "Total",
    median = map_dbl(Total, median),
    lower = map_dbl(Total, ~quantile(.x, 0.025)),
    upper = map_dbl(Total, ~quantile(.x, 0.975)),
    significant = map_lgl(Total, ~sign(quantile(.x, 0.025)) == sign(quantile(.x, 0.975)))
  ) |>
  rename(samples = Total)

# Combine all effects
all_effects <- bind_rows(effects_summary, total_effects) |>
  mutate(effect_type = factor(effect_type, levels = c("Direct", "Indirect", "Total")))

# Create publication-quality plot
all_effects |>
  filter(effect_type != "Total") |>  # Show only direct and indirect for clarity
  ggplot(aes(x = median, y = response, color = effect_type, shape = effect_type)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper, alpha = significant),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
    size = 0.8,
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Direct" = "#E64B35", "Indirect" = "#4DBBD5"),
    name = "Effect Type"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("Direct" = 16, "Indirect" = 17),
    name = "Effect Type"
  ) +
  scale_alpha_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = 1, "FALSE" = 0.4),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Standardized Effect Size",
    y = "",
    title = "Temperature Effects on Ecosystem Components",
    subtitle = "Direct effects and indirect effects mediated through coral decline"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "gray40")
  )

# Print summary table
cat("\n=== Temperature Effects Summary ===\n\n")
all_effects |>
  select(response, effect_type, median, lower, upper, significant) |>
  mutate(across(median:upper, ~round(.x, 3))) |>
  arrange(response, effect_type) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r temp-indirect-ranking}
#| label: fig-temp-indirect
#| fig-cap: "Ranking of indirect temperature effects on ecosystem components"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6

# Extract only indirect effects and rank them
indirect_effects <- all_effects |>
  filter(effect_type == "Indirect") |>
  # Remove coral (no indirect effect)
  filter(response != "Coral Cover") |>
  arrange(median) |>
  mutate(
    response = fct_reorder(response, median),
    direction = if_else(median < 0, "Negative", "Positive")
  )

# Create ranked bar plot
indirect_effects |>
  ggplot(aes(x = response, y = median, fill = direction, alpha = significant)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "gray30", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
    width = 0.1,
    linewidth = 0.8,
    color = "gray20",
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Negative" = "#E64B35", "Positive" = "#4DBBD5"),
    name = "Effect Direction"
  ) +
  scale_alpha_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = 0.9, "FALSE" = 0.2),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Standardized Indirect Effect Size",
    title = "Indirect Effects of Temperature via Coral Decline",
  #  subtitle = "Ranked from negative to positive effects with 95% credible intervals"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 17, margin = margin(t = 10)),
   # legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 15),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 19, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 15, color = "gray40")
  )

# Print ranked summary
cat("\n=== Ranked Indirect Effects (negative to positive) ===\n\n")
indirect_effects |>
  select(response, median, lower, upper, significant) |>
  mutate(across(median:upper, ~round(.x, 3))) |>
  arrange(median) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

## SEM Conditional Effects

```{r sem-conditional}
#| label: fig-sem-conditional
#| fig-cap: "Key relationships from structural equation model"
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 18

# Get unscaling parameters
Yearmodelvalues <- Year_Averages |>
  mutate(
    logfleshy = log(mean_fleshy),
    logproducers = log(mean_alive),
    logrd = log(Rd),
    logpmax = log(Pmax),
    N_percent = log(N_percent),
    yearresid = yearresid
  ) |>
  select(
    Year, meancoral = mean_coral, meanfleshy = mean_fleshy,
    temperature = Max_temp, flow = Flow_mean, Npercent = N_percent,
    logrd, logpmax, logcoral = log_coral, logproducers,
    logfleshy, Corallivore, herbs = Herbivores, yearresid
  ) |>
  drop_na(logcoral)

modelmean <- Yearmodelvalues |>
  summarise(across(everything(), mean, na.rm = TRUE))

modelsd <- Yearmodelvalues |>
  summarise(across(everything(), sd, na.rm = TRUE))

# Year -> Temperature
temp_year <- conditional_effects(brms_sem_full, resp = "temperature", effects = "Year")
ty_plot <- as_tibble(temp_year$temperature.temperature_Year) |>
  mutate(
    Year = Year * modelsd$Year + modelmean$Year,
    estimate__ = estimate__ * modelsd$temperature + modelmean$temperature,
    lower__ = lower__ * modelsd$temperature + modelmean$temperature,
    upper__ = upper__ * modelsd$temperature + modelmean$temperature
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = estimate__)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__), alpha = 0.25, fill = "#67bed9") +
  geom_point(data = Year_Averages, aes(x = Year, y = Max_temp), alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Temperature (°C)",
    title = "G. Year → Temperature"
  )

# Temperature -> Coral
coral_temp <- conditional_effects(brms_sem_full, resp = "logcoral", effects = "temperature")
ct_plot <- as_tibble(coral_temp$logcoral.logcoral_temperature) |>
  mutate(
    temperature = temperature * modelsd$temperature + modelmean$temperature,
    estimate__ = exp(estimate__ * modelsd$logcoral + modelmean$logcoral),
    lower__ = exp(lower__ * modelsd$logcoral + modelmean$logcoral),
    upper__ = exp(upper__ * modelsd$logcoral + modelmean$logcoral)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = temperature, y = estimate__)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__), alpha = 0.25, fill = "#67bed9") +
  geom_point(data = Year_Averages, aes(x = Max_temp, y = exp(log_coral)), alpha = 0.5) +
  coord_trans(y = "log") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(1, 5, 10, 20, 40)) +
  labs(
    x = "Temperature (°C)",
    y = "Coral Cover (%)",
    title = "E. Temperature → Coral"
  )

# Coral -> Respiration
rd_coral <- conditional_effects(brms_sem_full, resp = "logrd", effects = "logcoral")
rc_plot <- as_tibble(rd_coral$logrd.logrd_logcoral) |>
  mutate(
    logcoral = exp(logcoral * modelsd$logcoral + modelmean$logcoral),
    estimate__ = exp(estimate__ * modelsd$logrd + modelmean$logrd),
    lower__ = exp(lower__ * modelsd$logrd + modelmean$logrd),
    upper__ = exp(upper__ * modelsd$logrd + modelmean$logrd)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = logcoral, y = estimate__)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__), alpha = 0.25, fill = "#67bed9") +
  geom_point(data = Year_Averages, aes(x = exp(log_coral), y = Rd), alpha = 0.5) +
  coord_trans(x = "log", y = "log") +
  labs(
    x = "Coral Cover (%)",
    y = expression(atop("Ecosystem Respiration", "(mmol O"[2]*" m"^-2*" hr"^-1*")")),
    title = "B. Coral → Respiration"
  )

# Coral -> Fleshy Algae
fleshy_coral <- conditional_effects(brms_sem_full, resp = "logfleshy", effects = "logcoral")
fc_plot <- as_tibble(fleshy_coral$logfleshy.logfleshy_logcoral) |>
  mutate(
    logcoral = exp(logcoral * modelsd$logcoral + modelmean$logcoral),
    estimate__ = exp(estimate__ * modelsd$logfleshy + modelmean$logfleshy),
    lower__ = exp(lower__ * modelsd$logfleshy + modelmean$logfleshy),
    upper__ = exp(upper__ * modelsd$logfleshy + modelmean$logfleshy)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = logcoral, y = estimate__)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__), alpha = 0.25, fill = "#67bed9") +
  geom_point(data = Year_Averages, aes(x = exp(log_coral), y = mean_fleshy), alpha = 0.5) +
  coord_trans(x = "log", y = "log") +
  labs(
    x = "Coral Cover (%)",
    y = "Fleshy Macroalgae Cover (%)",
    title = "F. Coral → Macroalgae"
  )

# Coral -> Corallivores
corallivore_coral <- conditional_effects(brms_sem_full, resp = "Corallivore", effects = "logcoral")
cc_plot <- as_tibble(corallivore_coral$Corallivore.Corallivore_logcoral) |>
  mutate(
    logcoral = exp(logcoral * modelsd$logcoral + modelmean$logcoral),
    estimate__ = estimate__ * modelsd$Corallivore + modelmean$Corallivore,
    lower__ = lower__ * modelsd$Corallivore + modelmean$Corallivore,
    upper__ = upper__ * modelsd$Corallivore + modelmean$Corallivore
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = logcoral, y = estimate__)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__), alpha = 0.25, fill = "#67bed9") +
  geom_point(data = Year_Averages, aes(x = exp(log_coral), y = Corallivore), alpha = 0.5) +
  coord_trans(x = "log") +
  labs(
    x = "Coral Cover (%)",
    y = expression(atop("Corallivore Fish Biomass", "(g m"^-2*")")),
    title = "C. Coral → Corallivores"
  )

# Fleshy Algae -> Herbivores
herbs_fleshy <- conditional_effects(brms_sem_full, resp = "herbs", effects = "logfleshy")
hf_plot <- as_tibble(herbs_fleshy$herbs.herbs_logfleshy) |>
  mutate(
    logfleshy = exp(logfleshy * modelsd$logfleshy + modelmean$logfleshy),
    estimate__ = estimate__ * modelsd$herbs + modelmean$herbs,
    lower__ = lower__ * modelsd$herbs + modelmean$herbs,
    upper__ = upper__ * modelsd$herbs + modelmean$herbs
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = logfleshy, y = estimate__)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__), alpha = 0.25, fill = "#67bed9") +
  geom_point(data = Year_Averages, aes(x = mean_fleshy, y = Herbivores), alpha = 0.5) +
  coord_trans(x = "log") +
  labs(
    x = "Fleshy Macroalgae Cover (%)",
    y = expression(atop("Herbivore Fish Biomass", "(g m"^-2*")")),
    title = "D. Macroalgae → Herbivores"
  )

# Respiration -> N Content
N_Rd <- conditional_effects(brms_sem_full, resp = "Npercent", effects = "logrd")
nr_plot <- as_tibble(N_Rd$Npercent.Npercent_logrd) |>
  mutate(
    logrd = exp(logrd * modelsd$logrd + modelmean$logrd),
    estimate__ = exp(estimate__ * modelsd$Npercent + modelmean$Npercent),
    lower__ = exp(lower__ * modelsd$Npercent + modelmean$Npercent),
    upper__ = exp(upper__ * modelsd$Npercent + modelmean$Npercent)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = logrd, y = estimate__)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__), alpha = 0.25, fill = "#67bed9") +
  geom_point(data = Year_Averages, aes(x = Rd, y = N_percent), alpha = 0.5) +
  coord_trans(x = "log", y = "log") +
  labs(
    x = expression("Ecosystem Respiration (mmol O"[2]*" m"^-2*" hr"^-1*")"),
    y = "Nitrogen Content (%)",
    title = "A. Respiration → N Stock"
  )

# Combine plots with centering for single-plot rows
# Using plot_layout(widths = c(1, 2, 1)) to ensure centered plots are same size as others
((plot_spacer() | nr_plot | plot_spacer()) + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 2, 1))) /
  ((plot_spacer() | rc_plot | plot_spacer()) + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 2, 1))) /
  (cc_plot + hf_plot) /
  (ct_plot + fc_plot) /
  ((plot_spacer() | ty_plot | plot_spacer()) + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 2, 1))) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1, 1, 1, 1))
```

```{r predictions}
# Predict Rd

Rd_pred_plot <- exp(as_tibble(pred_new_Rd * modelsd$logrd + modelmean$logrd)) |>

# Predict N content
newdata_N <- data.frame(logrd = colMeans(pred_new_Rd))
pred_new_N <- posterior_epred(brms_sem_full, newdata = newdata_N, resp = "Npercent")

N_pred_plot <- exp(as_tibble(pred_new_N * modelsd$Npercent + modelmean$Npercent)) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = everything()) |>
  mutate(year = case_when(

  )) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = value, x = year)) +
  stat_halfeye(
    point_interval = mean_hdi, .width = c(.95, .75),

    data = hind_values, aes(x = as.character(Year), y = N_percent),

# Combine predictions
(Temp_pred_plot / Coral_pred_plot / Rd_pred_plot / N_pred_plot)
```
